title: PublicSurfaceState
description: DNS/TLS/reachability surface for a doorway hostname. Source of truth: external probes (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

dnsTarget.description: Resolved A/AAAA target, when DNS resolves.

tlsExpiresInDays.description: Days until TLS cert expires (negative if already expired).

publicReachable.description: True when an external probe can reach the doorway.
